cases.case_label: FKTN 3'UTR SVA founder insertion in trans with c.647+2084G>T
cases.mechanism_detail: All 10 patients with the second most common haplotype were compound heterozygous for the founder SVA insertion in the fukutin 3' UTR and the deep-intronic pseudoexon variant c.647+2084G>T; the paper characterises the point mutation, not the SVA mechanism.
cases.quote: we performed mutational analysis of 10 patients with the second most prevalent haplotype and found that all of them were compound-heterozygous for the SVA insertion and this c.647+2084G>T mutation.
